diagnosis.summary: 遍历意图、初始化和比较方向都正确，但循环条件写成了 $i <= n$，最后一次迭代会访问 `arr[n]`，超出合法下标范围 [0, $n$-1]，属于越界读（未定义行为）。
diagnosis.summary_en: The loop condition $i <= n$ reads `arr[n]`, which is out of bounds and undefined in C. The questionnaire focuses on valid index ranges and loop termination.

issues.description: 循环条件 $i <= n$ 导致访问 `arr[n]`，对长度 $n$ 的数组越界，在 C 中是未定义行为，可能返回垃圾值或崩溃
issues.description_en: The loop condition $i <= n$ reads `arr[n]` when i = n, which is out of bounds (undefined behavior).

questions.question: 长度为 $n$ 的 C 数组 arr，合法的下标范围是？
questions.question_en: For a C array arr of length n, what is the range of valid indices?

questions.question: 以下哪个循环恰好访问 `arr[0]` 到 `arr[n-1]`，不多也不少？
questions.question_en: Which loop visits exactly `arr[0]` through `arr[n-1]`, no more and no less?

questions.question: 当程序读取 `arr[n]` 时，C 语言标准如何定义这个行为？
questions.question_en: When the program reads `arr[n]`, how does the C standard define that behavior?
choices: 返回一个随机值，但程序其余部分完全正常
未定义行为（Undefined Behavior），可能崩溃、可能读到垃圾值，任何结果都可能
编译器会在运行时自动拦截并报错
choices_en: Returns a random value while the rest of the program behaves normally
Undefined behavior: it may crash, read garbage, or produce any other result
The compiler intercepts it at runtime and reports an error

questions.question: 你的循环条件里 $n$ 前面用的是 <=。请回答：对长度为 $n$ 的数组，最后一次合法访问的下标是多少？$i$ 等于多少时循环就必须停止？
questions.question_en: Your loop condition uses <= before n. Answer: for an array of length n, what is the last valid index, and at what value of i must the loop stop?
questions.expected_answer: 最后一次合法访问的下标是 n-1（即 arr[n-1]）；当 i == n 时循环必须停止，因为 arr[n] 已经不属于这个数组。

questions.question: 假设修改：把第 4 行的 $i <= n$ 改成 $i < n$，程序的行为会怎样？（点击本题可在左侧预览修改后的代码）
questions.question_en: Hypothetical change: replace $i <= n$ with $i < n$ on line 4. How does the behavior change? (Click this question to preview the modified code on the left)
choices: 会漏掉 `arr[n-1]`，最大值可能出错
消除了越界访问，程序变为正确
choices_en: It still reads `arr[n]` out of bounds
It skips `arr[n-1]`, so the maximum may be wrong
The out-of-bounds access disappears and the program becomes correct
